result.title: Engram Neuron Inspired Adaptive Memorization for Lifelong Learning
result.summary: Lifelong learning enables artificial systems to adapt to changing environments. To achieve this, an effective artificial learner should dynamically reorganize past and new experiences, maintaining stability while enabling flexible knowledge integration. However, existing efforts primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting, lacking the ability to adaptively update memory akin to biological systems. Here, by integrating the full memory life cycle of engram neurons into artificial learners, we propose a framework that constructs a structured memory from gradient representations, which regulates parameter updates and guides memory management. Through comprehensive evaluations on four benchmarks, our approach shows promising lifelong learning capability, maintaining stability over long task sequences and supporting flexible adaptation. Beyond the performance gains, our approach offers a computational perspective on robust and flexible lifelong learning, echoing mechanisms observed in biological memory systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该文借鉴「印迹神经元」（engram neuron）的完整记忆生命周期，从梯度表示中构建结构化记忆，用它调节参数更新并指导记忆管理，在四个基准上验证长期任务序列中的稳定性与灵活适应。
AI.relevance_reason: 属持续学习领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「由梯度表示构造结构化记忆并据此控制更新」的记忆生命周期视角，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的维护、记忆保留与新旧信息整合提供可核查的类比线索。
